title: Anatomi grafik
notes: Klik 1: kerangka sumbu. Klik 2: garis digambar. Klik 3: judul & label. Selalu beri judul, label sumbu, satuan.
text: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt hari = ["Sen", "Sel", "Rab", "Kam", "Jum"]suhu = [30, 32, 31, 29, 33] fig, ax = plt.subplots()ax.plot(hari, suhu, marker="o")ax.set_title("Suhu Harian")ax.set_xlabel("Hari")ax.set_ylabel("°C")plt.show()

title: Request-response
notes: Selalu pakai timeout dan raise_for_status(). Kode status: 2xx sukses, 4xx salah di klien, 5xx salah di server, 429 = terlalu sering.

appear: r = requests.get(url, params={"limit": 3}, timeout=10)r.raise_for_status() # error bila 4xx/5xxdata = r.json()

text: r = requests.get(url, params={"limit": 3}, timeout=10)r.raise_for_status() # error bila 4xx/5xxdata = r.json()

title: JSON
notes: Pada contoh ini respons_json adalah string JSON (dari r.text) berisi daftar pengguna dengan objek bersarang.

appear: json_normalize meratakan JSON bersarang jadi kolom: kota.nama.

text: import json, pandas as pdraw = respons_jsond = json.loads(raw)print(d["data"][0]["kota"]["nama"])df = pd.json_normalize(d["data"])print(df)

title: Error jaringan
notes: Satu except requests.exceptions.RequestException menangkap Timeout, ConnectionError, HTTPError.

appear: Siapkan fallback: cache lokal / data contoh agar program tetap jalan offline.

text: import requestsdef ambil(url): try: r = requests.get(url, timeout=5) r.raise_for_status() return r.json() except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print("Gagal:", type(e).__name__) return None

title: arXiv
notes: Feed arXiv berformat Atom XML dengan namespace — itu sebabnya ns diperlukan. Notebook menyediakan sampel feed bila jaringan terblokir.
text: import xml.etree.ElementTree as ETns = {"a": "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"}root = ET.fromstring(feed_xml)for e in root.findall("a:entry", ns): print(e.find("a:title", ns).text, e.find("a:published", ns).text[:10])
